compute_scope.future: No training hypothesis, training cap, model arm, checkpoint, GPU allocation, or execution is specified or authorized.

controls.FIXED_TURN_ROTATION_CONTROL: Same base tuple and output representation; output rotates the input L_TRIOMINO by exactly +1 turn independent of marker, testing transformation execution without marker binding.
controls.MARKER_BINDING_CONTROL: Same base tuple and marker/layout/color marginals; output is a four-cell direction code with the active position equal to control_marker_turn, testing marker-to-turn interpretation without shape rotation.
controls.NO_TRANSFORM_RETENTION_CONTROL: Same base tuple and agreed shape rendering; output preserves the input L_TRIOMINO orientation exactly (no canonical-orientation normalization and no marker-dependent transform), testing copying/representation retention.
controls.ROTATION_TARGET: Output is the input L_TRIOMINO transformed by control_marker_turn, retaining the agreed output rendering.

future_implementation_requirement: New source revision required before any generation; it must bind this V2 design and pass content/latent identity gates.
future_manifest_requirements: canonical TRAIN/validation content and latent manifests
source revision and deterministic input record

independent_unit.definition: One independent canonical base tuple excludes condition. Each condition is a paired view rendered from this same tuple; condition views, serializations, and relabelings are repeated measurements, never additional independent units.

invalidation_rules: missing or mismatched design/source/manifest identity => INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE
TRAIN-validation content or latent overlap => INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE
reserved cell present in TRAIN or a factor level absent marginally from TRAIN => INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE
fewer than 48 independent validation base tuples => INCONCLUSIVE
any condition treated as an independent unit => INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE
unmatched or functionally insufficient control => INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE

primary_estimand.definition: For each reserved cell, among independent validation base tuples where both FIXED_TURN_ROTATION_CONTROL and MARKER_BINDING_CONTROL are exact for V7, calculate the V7 ROTATION_TARGET exact-grid failure rate. Macro-average equally over four cells only if each has at least 8 conditional analyzable tuples.
primary_estimand.interpretation: A nonzero conditional failure is descriptive diagnostic evidence only; it does not establish a training mechanism or authorize an intervention.
primary_estimand.model: V7 only; no candidate arm, training arm, or comparator is defined or implied.
primary_estimand.name: V7 conditional rotation-target failure among prerequisite-success base tuples
secondary: unconditional V7 ROTATION_TARGET exact-grid accuracy by cell and macro average
V7 exact-grid accuracy for each of FIXED_TURN_ROTATION_CONTROL, MARKER_BINDING_CONTROL, and NO_TRANSFORM_RETENTION_CONTROL

prohibitions: No Gold, dGold, FINAL_AUDIT, or sealed evaluation access

train_base_tuple_balance.condition_rendering: Every TRAIN base tuple renders all four paired condition views.
train_base_tuple_balance.factor_coverage: Every shape_orientation and every reference_relation appears in multiple allowed TRAIN cells; the four diagonal cells remain excluded.

per_allowed_cell_marginals.color_role_permutation: 24 distinct deterministic permutations with background/shape/marker/output roles; no fixed color-position association
per_allowed_cell_marginals.layout_template: 2 each across the twelve named templates

uncertainty.bootstrap: reserved-cell-stratified bootstrap at independent base-tuple level; paired condition views retained within resample
uncertainty.insufficient_conditional_count: INCONCLUSIVE; never pool or count condition views as independent units.

validation_unit_plan.conditional_minimum_rule: If fewer than 8 of 12 base tuples in any reserved cell have both prerequisite controls exact, the conditional target estimand is INCONCLUSIVE for that cell and overall.
validation_unit_plan.paired_condition_views: all four conditions per base tuple; views are repeated measurements only
